messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable mobile-first apocalyptic racing RPG browser game from an empty repo, matching the user's detailed character, boss, map, weather, terrain, vehicle, audio, menu, and settings requirements.

## Requirements
- Character creator: any name, male/female, face styles, hair/hair color, facial hair, scars, eyes/eye colors; NPC/playable origins human, mutant, ghost, ghoul, demon, demigod.
- First race is a tutorial of controls and gameplay.
- 3 main bosses: Mandy-Lee (black hair, shocking blue eyes), Zanrich (wild animal demigod), Drikus the Insane (joker demigod); 8 underbosses (Ichi, Chloe, Jill, Timone, Domino, Bubbles, Oscar, Sussie).
- Open map quests: transport, taxi, single race, cup race, tournaments, escape gang, apocalyptic police, PvP.
- Race lengths: short 2–5 laps, medium 2–3, long 1–2; difficulties easy–hard.
- 15 apocalyptic terrains and 8 weather systems with dangerous lightning and wind.
- Dark scary classical-instrument music; speed/smoothness optimized for mobile.
- Login/profile, main menu with Start/Continue/Settings/Exit; Start, Continue, Settings (sound, video, gore level blood/zombie green blood, terms, save/load), Exit.
- Menu styled with chains, blood, body parts, vehicles; vehicles acquired through missions, career, special events and can be equipped.
- Latest user control requirement: left side = left/right turn pedals; right side = acceleration, stop/reverse, handbrake, nitro, special move pedals.

## Decisions
- Stack: Vite + Three.js; all visuals/audio procedurally generated, fonts downloaded locally.
- Single-player with local AI “PvP”; “open map” implemented as an interactive mission map rather than free-roam.
- Profiles and autosaves use `localStorage`; 3 manual save slots.
- RaceGame implements arcade physics, track spline, AI, laps, weather hazards, cargo/taxi/escape modes, special origin abilities, handbrake drift, reverse.
- Cup/tournament series use championship points (10/8/6/4/2/1, target 20/30).
- Browser exit implemented as logout/exit overlay because web pages cannot close tabs.

## Work State
### Completed
- `package.json`, Vite setup, local fonts under `public/fonts/`.
- `src/data.js`: origins, appearance options, 15 terrains, 8 weathers, difficulties, 16 vehicles, 11 bosses, 13 missions, tutorial data.
- `src/storage.js`: profiles, autosave, 3 slots, settings, formatting.
- `src/audio.js`: procedural dark orchestral music, engine synth, SFX.
- `src/portrait.js`: layered canvas character/boss portraits.
- `src/menu-bg.js`: animated Three.js apocalyptic menu backdrop with car, rain, lightning, ruined skyline.
- `src/car.js`: procedural low-poly vehicles.
- `src/track.js`: procedural spline tracks, road textures, terrains, props, weather, lightning, tornado.
- `src/race.js`: race engine, AI, HUD, touch controls updated for left turn pedals and right accel/stop-reverse/handbrake/nitro/special pedals, special abilities, reverse, drift, weather, results data.
- `src/garage.js`: rotating 3D vehicle preview.
- `src/decor.js`: chain/blood/skull/bone SVG chrome, terms text.
- `src/app.js`: login, creation, menu, map, career, garage, settings, events, race lifecycle, pause, results, progression implemented.
- `index.html` created with app/canvas/modal containers and splash.

### Active
- CSS has not been written yet: `src/styles.css` is missing.
- `src/main.js` is missing (must import CSS and instantiate `App`).
- `src/app.js` race methods were appended but syntax/behavior not yet verified.
- Need to verify `RaceGame` mode HUD labels support `cup`/`tournament`, camera shake setting behavior, and other integration polish.

### Blocked
- None, but build will fail until `styles.css` and `main.js` exist.

## Next Move
1. Create `src/main.js` importing `./styles.css` and instantiating `new App()`.
2. Write comprehensive `src/styles.css` for all screens/classes, especially login, menu, creation, map, career, garage, settings, events, race HUD, left/right mobile pedals, results/pause modals, responsive safe areas.
3. Run `npm run build`; fix syntax/import errors.
4. Start preview and use Playwright/browser checks: create profile, menu, tutorial/race, map mission, garage, career, settings, mobile viewport.
5. Verify controls visually/functionally (left turn pedals; right accel/stop-reverse/handbrake/nitro/special), race completion/results/progression.
6. Add `cup`/`tournament` to RaceGame `modeNames`, ensure camera-shake setting is honored, and fix any discovered bugs.
7. Commit changes if required and provide brief assumptions summary.

## Relevant Files
- `src/app.js`: main UI/routing/game progression; newest and largest file; needs syntax validation.
- `src/race.js`: core gameplay, HUD, touch controls, specials/reverse/handbrake.
- `src/track.js`: terrain/weather/track generation and hazards.
- `src/data.js`: all game content definitions.
- `src/storage.js`: profile/save models.
- `src/portrait.js`: character and boss portrait renderer.
- `src/car.js`: vehicle mesh builder.
- `src/garage.js`: garage 3D preview.
- `src/menu-bg.js`: animated menu backdrop.
- `src/audio.js`: music/SFX/engine audio.
- `src/decor.js`: decorative SVG assets and terms copy.
- `index.html`: shell markup and mount points.
- `package.json`: Vite/Three dependencies and scripts.
- `public/fonts/`: locally hosted Bebas Neue, Barlow Condensed, Special Elite.
- `src/styles.css` (missing): must be created.
- `src/main.js` (missing): must be created.

## Important Context
- Vite dev/build expected; `npm install` already completed (`three@0.169.0`, `vite@5.4.10`).
- `src/app.js` currently ends with the `App` class closed after `showRaceResults`.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable mobile-first apocalyptic racing RPG browser game in the current repo, matching the user's detailed character, boss, map, weather, terrain, vehicle, audio, menu, and settings requirements.

## Requirements

messages.text:
"Main Character you can type any name in. And can choose male or female. Different styles of faces,hair and hair color, facial hair,scars,eyes, eyes colors.  First race is a tutorial of the controls and gameplay.  3 main boss drivers to win is Mandy-Lee(black hair with shocking blue eyes,  queen of the dark and scary), Zanrich the wild animal behavior driver(demi god of power and strength)and last the main boss \"Drikus the Insane\"demi god of insanity mixed joker look. 8 general underboss drivers. Ichi main underboss(anubis looks with Egyptian godlike vehicle). Chloe the white cerberus looking dog with mean looking vehicle. Jill the fast and majestic underboss. Timone the sheep and evil sheep vehicle.  Domino the sly fox with skillful vehicle,  Bubbles yhe goof with weird looking doggy car. Oscar the midnight black driver and black vehicle. Sussie the fat black driver with lots of speed boosts.Sky background of the game is apocalyptic weather(acid rain,thunderstorm, twister, hurricanes,floods,quicksand,clear sky,cloudy)with dangerous lighting and wind. Single player,open map quests(transport,taxi,single race,cup race, tournaments, escape gang and apocalyptic police,pvp). NPC are human, mutant, ghosts,ghouls, demons,demi gods (all playable characters as well).Their must be short(2-5 laps), medium(2-3 laps),long(1-2 laps). Game difficulties from easy to hard. 15 different types of terrain with apocalyptic genre(including sand dunes,mountains,desert,war zone,rain forest,dystopia, mines,beach, city,suburbs,jungle, ice tundra,volcanoes,). Focus on speed and smoothness of the graphics suited for most mobile games. Dark scary classical instrument music.  First must start the game while logging in to profile. Open the main menu. Start the game, continue the game, settings where you can adjust sound,video quality,  gore level of the game(blood/zombie green blood), terms and conditions, save/load game) and an exit the game. Menu must look with chains,blood, body parts and vehicles. You can change apocalyptic style vehicles that you acquire through missions, career and special events.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
